title: An Integrative Procedure for Apoptosis Identification and Measurement
protocol: Culture cancer cells in RPMI 1640 supplemented with 10% FBS, 10mM HEPES plus penicillin-streptomycin.
Induce apoptosis with an apoptosis-inducing drug for 24 hours.
Culture control group cells in medium without the drug at a density of 10^4-6/ml in a flat-bottom plate.
Trpisinize cancer cells (1-2×10^7) with 1 ml 0.25% trypsin at 37°C for 2-3 minutes until cells detach completely from the plate.
Add 0.5%FBS-RPMI 1640 medium to terminate trypsinization and pipette gently to disrupt cell clumps into single cells.
Transfer cells into an eppendorf tube, spin at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet with 1×PBS at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes twice.
Resuspend cells into single-cell status with a little 1×PBS (20 μl).
Add 2 ml of 70% ethanol to fix cells, place at -20°C overnight.
Centrifuge at 1000 rpm for 10 minutes; discard the supernatant to remove ethanol thoroughly.
Resuspend cells with 0.5 ml of 1×PBS, transfer into a micro-eppendorf tube, spin at 1500 rpm for 10 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Add 40 μl of 0.2M phosphate-citric acid buffer (pH7.8) to each tube respectively.
Stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes with intermittent shaking.
Spin at 1000 rpm for 10 min.
Transfer the supernatant to new micro-eppendorf tubes.
Incubate the cell pellets on ice for fluorescence observation and for flow cytometric analysis.
Add 3 μl of 0.25% NP40 to the supernatant.
Add 3 μl of RNase A solution (1 mg/ml) to the supernatant.
Vortex the mixture thoroughly.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Add again 3 μl Proteinase K (1 mg/ml) to the mixture.
Vortex thoroughly.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Mix each 16 μl reaction solution thoroughly with 2 μl 6x DNA loading buffer.
Resolve the DNA ladder on a 0.8% 1x TAE agarose gel after electrophoresis at constant voltage 2 V/cm for 2 h.
Visualize by UV light after standard ethidium bromide staining.
Resuspend the cell pellets with 0.5 ml 1x PBS.
Add 10 μl Proteinase K (1 mg/ml).
Vortex gently.
Stand at room temperature for 30 min.
Wash with 1 ml 1x PBS by spinning at 1000 rpm for 5 min × 2.
Resuspend again with 20 μl 1x PBS into single cells after discarding the supernatant.
Add 300 μl DNA staining solution (containing 150 μg/ml PI, 20 U/ml RNase A).
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Place a drop of single cell suspension on an air-drying glass slide.
Cover the cells with a glass coverslip to reduce light diffraction.
Observe cells using a fluorescence microscope equipped with a G.B filter and a 40× objective.
Use the remaining cell suspension for flow cytometry.
Analyze the ratio of apoptotic cells with MULTYCYCLE software.
